Verification: freshly downloaded pinned remote bytes, previously researched
local bytes and these vendored bytes match exactly. No line-ending, encoding,
copyright-header or script-logic changes were applied.

Behavior of these original scripts:
- Read a known Unity log header to find the game path, unless set_path is given.
- Locate a versioned webCaches Cache/Cache_Data/data_2 file.
- Copy the complete cache file to a GUID-named system temporary file.
- Read that entire copy and remove it after successful reading.
- Extract candidate getGachaLog URLs and make HTTP requests to test them.
- Keep five query parameters, print the resulting URL and copy it to clipboard.
- Enable TLS 1.2 in the current PowerShell process and load System.Web.

The originals do not enforce a hostname allowlist or a read-size limit and do
not use a finally block for temporary-file cleanup. They do not change the
machine execution policy, request administrator elevation, or modify game files.
These behavioral notes describe the unmodified upstream files, not guarantees
that every runtime environment will behave identically.
